messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: runtime-service v2.4.1 -> prod (canary 10%) at 1776128000. Rollout ID: rld-20260315-47.
sofia (eng-runtime): seeing p95 spike on canary hosts in us-west-2, started ~5m after canary. p50 stable, but p99 jumps from 120ms -> 2.3s.
pagerduty: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: INC-48720 - High tail latency for runtime-service in production. Escalation to oncall (irene (oncall)).
irene (oncall): oncall here, acknowledging. i'll grab traces and check canary hosts /logs, assigning to matt and josh.
matt (eng-sre): looking at trace sampling — requests from realtime routes show lots of kernel fallback messages and many small batches (batch_size=1). suspected kernel/selection problem.
josh (infra): confirming logs show fallback entries: ```[2026-03-15T10:07:12Z] WARN runtime: KERNEL_FALLBACK selected 'generic_gpu' for model gpt-small because optimized_kernel init failed: cudaKernelSelect: mismatch in conv config```
sofia (eng-runtime): that matches what I saw locally when trying the new kernel selector. Canary traffic isn't triggering the fallback during our unit tests, weird. maybe selector errs only under specific seq len distribution.
josh (infra): batching metrics show batcher.queue_len drop to ~0.2 on canary pods while request rate steady — looks like requests are being short-circuited to sync path due to kernel init failures.
matt (eng-sre): impact: increased token latency and cost. throughput per GPU down ~30% on canary nodes. canary users likely see slow streaming and higher tail.
carla (cs): any customer-facing impact yet? any VIPs hit?
sofia (eng-runtime): based on traces, a subset of real-time routes (low-latency chat) are hit hardest. CS: small number of sessions may have reported lag, not full request errors. recommend letting cs draft a short note.
irene (oncall): we need fast mitigation. options: 1) flip kill-switch for new-kernel-selection, 2) force rollback of the canary rollout, 3) apply a hotfix to kernel selector. flipping flag is lowest blast radius.
sofia (eng-runtime): agree. flag name: runtime.new_kernel_select. to toggle: ```./infra/tools/ffctl set runtime.new_kernel_select false --env=prod --rollout=immediate```
josh (infra): i can flip. executing now. ```ffctl set runtime.new_kernel_select false --env prod --id rld-20260315-47```
eng-sre-bot: Flag change recorded: runtime.new_kernel_select=false by josh at 1776128142.
matt (eng-sre): monitoring batcher and p99. please post updated metrics in 60s.
sofia (eng-runtime): after flag flip — one canary pod logged restart of runtime worker and reinitialized with legacy kernel.
sofia (eng-runtime): metrics update: p99 dropped from 2.3s -> 180ms within 90s on canary. throughput trending back up.
josh (infra): can confirm GPU utilization recovered and batch sizes returning to normal.
carla (cs): thanks — i'll inform affected customers: brief note that we saw a canary regress and we mitigated with a backend feature toggle; no data loss and most services restored.
irene (oncall): pager closed? any further actions before handoff?
matt (eng-sre): we should keep canary paused and run a targeted repro test on the new kernel selector with sequence distribution matching production. also add extra checks to canary gating for kernel init errors.
sofia (eng-runtime): opening follow-up ticket: RT-983 - investigate kernel selector fallback and widen canary test coverage. assigning to runtime kernel team.
irene (oncall): handing off to next oncall @maria in 30m. i'll stay on slack for 10min more then handover.
carla (cs): CS note drafted, will send within 20m.
sofia (eng-runtime): one more note: canary detection gap — alert threshold was set on p95 and not p99; will propose alert change to include kernel_fallback rate and batcher.queue_len anomalies.
matt (eng-sre): agree, will add rule: alert if kernel_fallback_rate > 0.5% for >2m.
irene (oncall): incident resolved for now, moving to monitoring state. keeping incident open for postmortem. :white_check_mark:
sofia (eng-runtime): thanks all. follow-up docs + repro steps linked in RT-983.
eng-sre-bot: Incident INC-48720 status -> mitigated at 1776128280, owner: irene (oncall).
